notes: Farming with a plant-harvest-sell-expand loop is Simulation, and the repeatable caretaking loop makes it Role Sim rather than Tycoon - there are no droppers, the player does the work at stations - while Roleplay & Avatar Sim is out because the player is the farmer running a defined loop, not an animal or an open-ended social character. Shape is plot-isolated because the answers give each player a separate farm that trusted connections visit, which the preset's world-open would have merged into one shared farm; path-road-vehicle is dropped since nothing is driven. trigger-task covers the flower plots and the feeding, brushing and egg collection, gate-progression the bought expansion to about twenty plots and a bigger barn, social-hub the adoption and gifting storefront, and npc-population the mini animals themselves. Without a user I treated the barn as open-fronted stalls worked from outside rather than an enterable interior, keeping the build on P0; if the barn should be walked into, that is a P3 upgrade to note.
